_comment: Read by meal-prep/pipeline/monitor-sitewide-prices.ps1 through meal-prep/lib/sitewide-price-lib.ps1. Two blocks. 'exempt' is the explicit, reasoned registry of live pages the monitor does not ask about, BY NAME, each naming its producer and the road that keeps its figures current; never a pattern. 'ratchet' is the day-one mark: the pages that stated a grocery price literal when the monitor shipped, with their counts. The mark may only FALL. A plain run never writes it; a run that measures fewer prints RATCHET CAN TIGHTEN and a person lowers the mark in a commit. Set 2026-09-22 for design/RCA-holistic-2026-09-22.md F1 (plan grocery/triage-plans/plan-2026-09-22-6.json).

exempt._why: A page is exempt only when the PIPELINE writes its figures from the board on a known cadence, so its copy of a board price has a road that regenerates it. A generated page with no such road is NOT exempt: /omaha-price-tracker/ is built daily by grocery/build-trend-index.ps1 and published by nothing (its header: 'Meant to be published manually'); the live copy was last modified 2026-09-05, so it stays in the monitored set until a road publishes it.

engine_recipes.why: built by the recipe engine; meal-prep/lib/price-literal-gate.ps1 refuses a literal at build and at publish, audit-live-price-contract.ps1 -LivePosts reads every published post daily, and monitor-live-recipe-prices.ps1 runs each page's own fill against the deployed feed

meal-prep-recipes.why: the recipe hub grid, rebuilt from the day's costs and republished daily by grocery/check-ad-cycles.ps1 (surface-hub); audit-surface-staleness.ps1 reads it

ratchet.why: Measured by the first live run of monitor-sitewide-prices.ps1 on 2026-09-22 (1,086 live URLs incl. the homepage: 600 exempt by name, 440 clean, 46 stating a grocery price, 0 unread). The 46 are the homepage injection, /omaha-price-tracker/ (generated, no publishing road) and 44 posts, including the four pre-engine recipe posts ruling A rebuilds. Not red on day one; each count may only fall.
